import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { addPropertyControls, ControlType, RenderTarget } from "framer"
import { motion } from "framer-motion"

/**
 * Registration page for a Webinar Studio webinar, with the Studio script built in.
 *
 * GENERATED BY WEBINAR STUDIO. Do not edit the script or the three values below by hand.
 *   Studio address : __STUDIO_ORIGIN__
 *   Webinar        : __CAMPAIGN_ID__
 *   Zoom event     : __ZOOM_ID__
 * If Studio's address or the webinar changes (a new domain, a restarted tunnel, a new webinar), generate this file again
 * and paste it over this one. Nothing about the webinar or the address is a property of the component, on purpose: a
 * property saved on the page overrides a default, and an old value kept on the page is what stopped registrations once.
 *
 * Paste the whole file into a Framer code component, put the component on your landing page, and publish.
 * Do NOT also paste Studio's script in Site Settings: this file already contains it (one copy is enough, two are harmless).
 *
 * @framerSupportedLayoutWidth any
 * @framerSupportedLayoutHeight any
 */

// The Studio script, exactly as Studio generates it for this webinar.
const STUDIO_SCRIPT = `__STUDIO_SCRIPT__`
const STUDIO_SCRIPT_ID = "webinar-studio-script"

export default function UniversalWebinarLanding({
    accentColor,
    backgroundColor,
    cardBgColor,
    badgeText,
    headline,
    subheadline,
    dateText,
    timeText,
    speakerName,
    speakerRole,
    keyPoint1,
    keyPoint2,
    keyPoint3,
    googleFormBackupUrl,
}) {
    // Install the Studio script once, on the published page and in preview, but not on Framer's editing canvas.
    useEffect(() => {
        if (RenderTarget.current() === RenderTarget.canvas) return
        if (typeof document === "undefined" || document.getElementById(STUDIO_SCRIPT_ID)) return
        const script = document.createElement("script")
        script.id = STUDIO_SCRIPT_ID
        script.type = "text/javascript"
        script.text = STUDIO_SCRIPT
        document.body.appendChild(script)
    }, [])

    // "idle" until the visitor presses the button, "submitting" while Studio is answering,
    // "failed" if Studio could not be reached or refused (the visitor is told and can try again).
    const [status, setStatus] = useState<"idle" | "submitting" | "failed">("idle")

    // The Studio script announces the outcome as a window event: detail.status is
    // "registered" | "closed" | "failed". Nothing breaks if it never fires (see the timeout below).
    useEffect(() => {
        const onStudio = (e: Event) => {
            const outcome = (e as CustomEvent).detail?.status
            setStatus(outcome === "failed" ? "failed" : "idle")
        }
        window.addEventListener("webinar-studio", onStudio)
        return () => window.removeEventListener("webinar-studio", onStudio)
    }, [])

    // Safety net: never leave the button stuck on "Reserving..." if no answer ever comes.
    useEffect(() => {
        if (status !== "submitting") return
        const t = setTimeout(() => setStatus("idle"), 20000)
        return () => clearTimeout(t)
    }, [status])

    const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
        // The page stays put; the Studio script sends the registration and shows the calendar pop-up.
        e.preventDefault()
        if (e.currentTarget.checkValidity()) setStatus("submitting")
    }

    const submitting = status === "submitting"

    const inputStyle = {
        width: "100%",
        padding: "12px 16px",
        borderRadius: 10,
        border: "1.5px solid #e2e8f0",
        fontSize: 14,
        color: "#0f172a",
        backgroundColor: "#f8fafc",
        outline: "none",
        boxSizing: "border-box" as const,
        fontFamily: "inherit",
        transition: "border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease",
    }

    const labelStyle = {
        display: "block",
        fontSize: 12,
        fontWeight: 600,
        color: "#475569",
        marginBottom: 6,
        textTransform: "uppercase" as const,
        letterSpacing: "0.03em",
    }

    return (
        <div
            style={{
                width: "100%",
                minHeight: "100vh",
                backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
                fontFamily:
                    '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif',
                color: "#0f172a",
                display: "flex",
                flexDirection: "column",
                alignItems: "center",
                padding: "60px 24px",
                boxSizing: "border-box",
            }}
        >
            <div
                style={{
                    width: "100%",
                    maxWidth: 1140,
                    display: "grid",
                    gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(340px, 1fr))",
                    gap: 56,
                    alignItems: "start",
                }}
            >
                {/* Left Column: Webinar Narrative */}
                <motion.div
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 18 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: "easeOut" }}
                    style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 24 }}
                >
                    <span
                        style={{
                            alignSelf: "flex-start",
                            padding: "6px 14px",
                            borderRadius: 9999,
                            fontSize: 12,
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            letterSpacing: "0.05em",
                            textTransform: "uppercase",
                            backgroundColor: `${accentColor}15`,
                            color: accentColor,
                            border: `1px solid ${accentColor}30`,
                        }}
                    >
                        {badgeText}
                    </span>

                    <h1
                        style={{
                            fontSize: "clamp(2.2rem, 4.5vw, 3.4rem)",
                            lineHeight: 1.15,
                            fontWeight: 800,
                            margin: 0,
                            letterSpacing: "-0.03em",
                            color: "#0f172a",
                        }}
                    >
                        {headline}
                    </h1>

                    <p style={{ fontSize: 17, lineHeight: 1.6, color: "#475569", margin: 0 }}>
                        {subheadline}
                    </p>

                    {/* Metadata Card */}
                    <div
                        style={{
                            display: "flex",
                            flexWrap: "wrap",
                            gap: 24,
                            padding: "18px 22px",
                            backgroundColor: cardBgColor,
                            borderRadius: 14,
                            border: "1px solid #e2e8f0",
                            boxShadow: "0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.02)",
                        }}
                    >
                        <div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, textTransform: "uppercase", color: "#64748b", fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: "0.04em" }}>
                                Schedule
                            </div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700, color: "#1e293b", marginTop: 4 }}>
                                {dateText} • {timeText}
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div style={{ borderLeft: "1px solid #e2e8f0", paddingLeft: 24 }}>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, textTransform: "uppercase", color: "#64748b", fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: "0.04em" }}>
                                Featured Host
                            </div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 700, color: "#1e293b", marginTop: 4 }}>
                                {speakerName}{" "}
                                <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 400, color: "#64748b" }}>
                                    ({speakerRole})
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Takeaway Bullets */}
                    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 14, marginTop: 10 }}>
                        <h3 style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, color: "#1e293b", margin: 0 }}>
                            Key takeaways:
                        </h3>

                        {[keyPoint1, keyPoint2, keyPoint3]
                            .filter(Boolean)
                            .map((point, index) => (
                                <div
                                    key={index}
                                    style={{
                                        display: "flex",
                                        alignItems: "flex-start",
                                        gap: 12,
                                        fontSize: 15,
                                        color: "#334155",
                                        lineHeight: 1.5,
                                    }}
                                >
                                    <div
                                        style={{
                                            width: 20,
                                            height: 20,
                                            borderRadius: "50%",
                                            backgroundColor: `${accentColor}20`,
                                            color: accentColor,
                                            display: "flex",
                                            alignItems: "center",
                                            justifyContent: "center",
                                            fontSize: 12,
                                            fontWeight: 800,
                                            flexShrink: 0,
                                            marginTop: 2,
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        ✓
                                    </div>
                                    <span>{point}</span>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                    </div>
                </motion.div>

                {/* Right Column: Registration form (the Studio script reads it by the field names below) */}
                <motion.div
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 22 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.1, ease: "easeOut" }}
                    style={{
                        backgroundColor: cardBgColor,
                        borderRadius: 24,
                        border: "1px solid #e2e8f0",
                        boxShadow: "0 20px 35px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06), 0 8px 12px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03)",
                        padding: "36px 32px",
                    }}
                >
                    <div style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
                        <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 800, color: "#0f172a" }}>
                            Confirm Your Registration
                        </h2>
                        <p style={{ margin: "6px 0 0", fontSize: 14, color: "#64748b" }}>
                            Enter your details below to receive direct calendar and Zoom links.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <form
                        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
                        style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 18 }}
                    >
                        {/* No hidden fields: the webinar, the Zoom event and the channel come from the link and the Studio script. */}

                        <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 14 }}>
                            <div>
                                <label style={labelStyle}>First Name *</label>
                                <input type="text" name="FirstName" required placeholder="John" style={inputStyle} />
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label style={labelStyle}>Last Name</label>
                                <input type="text" name="LastName" placeholder="Doe" style={inputStyle} />
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <label style={labelStyle}>Work Email *</label>
                            <input type="email" name="EmailAddress" required placeholder="john@company.com" style={inputStyle} />
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <label style={labelStyle}>Phone Number *</label>
                            <input type="tel" name="Phone" required placeholder="+1 (555) 000-0000" style={inputStyle} />
                        </div>

                        <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 14 }}>
                            <div>
                                <label style={labelStyle}>Company</label>
                                <input type="text" name="Company" placeholder="Acme Corp" style={inputStyle} />
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label style={labelStyle}>Job Title</label>
                                <input type="text" name="JobTitle" placeholder="Product Manager" style={inputStyle} />
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <motion.button
                            type="submit"
                            whileHover={{ scale: 1.01 }}
                            whileTap={{ scale: 0.99 }}
                            disabled={submitting}
                            style={{
                                marginTop: 10,
                                width: "100%",
                                padding: "14px 20px",
                                borderRadius: 12,
                                border: "none",
                                backgroundColor: accentColor,
                                color: "#ffffff",
                                fontSize: 16,
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                cursor: submitting ? "not-allowed" : "pointer",
                                opacity: submitting ? 0.75 : 1,
                                boxShadow: `0 10px 20px -5px ${accentColor}50`,
                                transition: "all 0.2s ease",
                            }}
                        >
                            {submitting ? "Reserving..." : "Register for Webinar →"}
                        </motion.button>

                        {/* Only when the registration did not go through: say so, and offer the backup form. */}
                        {status === "failed" && (
                            <div role="alert" style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#b91c1c", lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                                We could not complete your registration. Please try again
                                {googleFormBackupUrl ? (
                                    <>
                                        {" "}or use the{" "}
                                        <a
                                            href={googleFormBackupUrl}
                                            target="_blank"
                                            rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                            style={{ color: accentColor, fontWeight: 600 }}
                                        >
                                            backup form
                                        </a>
                                    </>
                                ) : null}
                                .
                            </div>
                        )}

                        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginTop: 4 }}>
                            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#94a3b8" }}>
                                🔒 Secure SSL Registration
                            </span>
                        </div>
                    </form>
                </motion.div>
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}

// Only what changes the look or the wording. The webinar, the Zoom event and Studio's address are NOT properties here
// on purpose: a property saved on the page overrides a default, which is how an old tunnel address stayed in use.
addPropertyControls(UniversalWebinarLanding, {
    googleFormBackupUrl: {
        title: "Backup form link",
        type: ControlType.String,
        defaultValue: "https://forms.gle/yAo4qaTJWtsrw21c9",
    },
    accentColor: { title: "Accent Color", type: ControlType.Color, defaultValue: "#2563eb" },
    backgroundColor: { title: "Background", type: ControlType.Color, defaultValue: "#f8fafc" },
    cardBgColor: { title: "Card Bg", type: ControlType.Color, defaultValue: "#ffffff" },
    badgeText: { title: "Badge Text", type: ControlType.String, defaultValue: "Live Strategy Masterclass" },
    headline: { title: "Headline", type: ControlType.String, defaultValue: "Scale Product Strategy & Growth in 2026" },
    subheadline: {
        title: "Subheadline",
        type: ControlType.String,
        defaultValue:
            "Join top operators for an intensive 60-minute teardown of execution frameworks, customer journeys, and scalable revenue loops.",
    },
    dateText: { title: "Date", type: ControlType.String, defaultValue: "Thursday, Nov 12" },
    timeText: { title: "Time", type: ControlType.String, defaultValue: "10:00 AM EST" },
    speakerName: { title: "Speaker", type: ControlType.String, defaultValue: "Sarah Jenkins" },
    speakerRole: { title: "Role", type: ControlType.String, defaultValue: "VP of Product" },
    keyPoint1: { title: "Takeaway 1", type: ControlType.String, defaultValue: "Frameworks for prioritizing high-velocity roadmaps" },
    keyPoint2: { title: "Takeaway 2", type: ControlType.String, defaultValue: "Aligning product telemetry with LeadSquared CRM automation" },
    keyPoint3: { title: "Takeaway 3", type: ControlType.String, defaultValue: "Live audience teardown and instant access to slides" },
})
